mapper.sql: SELECT p.cntrct_ty_cd,p.stlm_mthd_cd,p.use_yn FROM prj.prj p WHERE p.prj_id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT c.cls_stts_cd FROM fin.mth_cls c WHERE c.cls_ym=#{month}

SELECT a.asgn_id,a.dev_id,m.mm_qty, (SELECT h.bill_untprc_amt FROM asgn.untprc_hist h WHERE h.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND h.aply_bgn_dt <= GREATEST(a.bgn_dt,#{first}) ORDER BY h.aply_bgn_dt DESC LIMIT 1) IS NOT NULL AS price_available FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=a.prj_id LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND m.work_ym=#{month} WHERE a.prj_id=#{projectId} AND p.cntrct_ty_cd='DP' AND p.stlm_mthd_cd IN ('DAY','HOUR') AND a.untprc_base_cd=p.stlm_mthd_cd AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND a.bgn_dt <= #{last} AND a.end_dt >= #{first} ORDER BY a.dev_id,a.asgn_id
SELECT DISTINCT d.asgn_id FROM bill.bill_dtl d JOIN bill.bill b ON b.bill_id=d.bill_id WHERE b.prj_id=#{projectId} AND d.work_ym=#{month} AND b.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM' AND d.asgn_id IS NOT NULL

INSERT INTO bill.dspch_atnd(work_ym,prj_id,dev_id,asgn_id,work_day_qty, rglr_tm_qty,ovtm_tm_qty,mth_work_day_qty,created_by) VALUES(#{scope.month},#{scope.projectId},#{item.dev_id},#{item.asgn_id}, #{item.work_day_qty},#{item.rglr_tm_qty},#{item.ovtm_tm_qty},#{item.mth_work_day_qty},#{actor}) ON CONFLICT(work_ym,prj_id,dev_id) DO UPDATE SET asgn_id=EXCLUDED.asgn_id, work_day_qty=EXCLUDED.work_day_qty,rglr_tm_qty=EXCLUDED.rglr_tm_qty, ovtm_tm_qty=EXCLUDED.ovtm_tm_qty,mth_work_day_qty=EXCLUDED.mth_work_day_qty, updated_by=#{actor} RETURNING atnd_id
